What we make for you

Bring an idea or a finished file. We design it, print it and get it ready for your customers.

  • Graphic Design

    Flyers, posters, invitations and social media graphics made to your brief.

  • Branding

    Logos and a consistent look, so your business is recognised wherever it appears.

  • Printing

    Digital and large-format printing for documents, banners and marketing materials.

  • Signage

    Shop signs and display boards that people notice from the road.

  • Stationery

    Business cards, letterheads and other office paper carrying your branding.

  • Invitations

    Embossed and foil invitation cards for weddings, engagements and events.

  • Souvenirs

    Branded notebooks, keyrings, tissue boxes, towels and gift bags for weddings and events.

  • Awards and frames

    Acrylic award plaques, framed certificates and custom wall clocks.

  • Book design and printing

    Cover design, layout and printed copies for authors, in English and Arabic.

  • ...and much more

    Not on the list? Message us on WhatsApp and ask.

Founder & CEO

Meet the Founder

Abubakar Bello Umar

Founder & CEO, Abelma Digitals and Creative Solutions Ltd.

  • A.B.U Design
  • A.B.U Graphics
  • A.B.U Digitals
  • Abelma Digitals

The story of Abelma began around 2021 and grew through different ideas and names before becoming Abelma Digitals and Creative Solutions Ltd. The journey was driven by one growing purpose: to solve creative, digital, organizational and business challenges through practical and innovative solutions.

Established 22 August 2026Registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC), RC 9338930

Today, Abelma is being built with a much bigger vision: to become one of Africa’s biggest and most respected creative companies, and ultimately a globally recognized creative brand.
